messages.subject: Singular matrix error in mqmscan
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to do an mqmscan with an F2 cross, 112 individuals with 3192 markers distributed across 49 linkage groups. I have two questions regarding this process.

The first concerns the mqmaugmentdata method of filling in missing data. The function is taking a very long time to run on a cluster, probably because of the large number of markers. Is it likely to finish in a reasonable amount of time with such a large dataset? Even a couple of weeks is fine.

The second question concerns the singular matrix error that many other people have run into in this group. When using fill.geno to simulate missing data, mqmscan gives the error, Singular Matrix. Following some advice posted in another discussion, I've tried to isolate the linkage group responsible for the error. While no one linkage group is causing the failure, it seems that any combination of linkage groups containing about 1500 markers will produce the singular matrix error. Combinations containing less than 1400 markers consistently work with mqmscan. This seems to suggest the the problem is either caused by too many markers or too much map distance. Are there any suggestions with how to resolve this error? There are definitely duplicate markers in the map, but those don't seem to cause a problem if I artificially trim the dataset.

I have successfully mapped my QTL with scanone, and stepwiseqtl, but it would be nice to further validate those results with mqmscan.

Thanks,
Tyler
